system.description:
You have learned how to fight with the rapid-fire speed of a rabbit: You fight with your feet as you strike multiple times with light kicks.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6.

While in this stance, your movement speed increases by 10 feet.

Your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from creatures you have dealt [Unarmed Damage] to this turn.

Beginning at 5th level, Once per turn, in place of one of your attacks granted by the Attack action or when you make a melee Taijutsu attack, you can perform a Bunny Roundhouse.

Bunny Roundhouse. Make an unarmed attack, comparing the result to all hostile creatures within your unarmed attacks range, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] to each if it would score a hit.

Beginning at 10th level, Once per turn, as a Bonus Action, you can select a space you can see within 20 feet of you, and leap towards it, ending your movement there. If you end this movement within 5 feet of an allied creature you can throw them into a space of their choice that you can see within 20 feet of you as they land safely.
